title: GARFIELD'S HARDCORE MIXTAPE
description: a simple resource pack that replaces the vanilla minecraft discs with happy hardcore/breakbeat songs from the mid 1990s
body:
this is just a simple resource pack for 1.20.x that replaces the vanilla minecraft discs with happy hardcore/breakbeat songs from the mid 1990s (plus some silent hill tracks for the "scary" music discs).
i made this for myself initially but then decided to upload it online
